name: History Lab
tagline: Replay history — and fact-check the AI to win.
description: A branching, illustrated historical decision game where catching the AI's hallucinations is the core mechanic. Anna's host agent streams a grounded scene and three plausible choices and generates period art; before the timeline advances, you must Approve its 'Historian's Ruling' or Flag it as a hallucination. Only approved rulings commit to durable state, while your fact-checking accuracy updates live. AI generates, the human ratifies, Anna remembers.
